description: Partner-vehicle type in two-vehicle crashes (ref: car): crude and adjusted RRs of 'killed' (CRSS occupants of light passenger vehicles aged 8+ (known age))
population: CRSS occupants of light passenger vehicles aged 8+ (known age), two-vehicle crashes
method: Crude: weighted rate and saturated survey logit; Survey-weighted logistic regression (pseudo-ML, ridge 0.01), Taylor-linearised variance (25 strata, 67 PSUs, t with 42 df); standardised predictive margins -> adjusted RR/RD. Model A = person covariates + PRE_CRASH; model B = A + crash type + number of vehicles. Partner-determined flags (any heavy truck / motorcycle) dropped.
